hero.headline: Cut Call Volumes & Boost Grid Visibility—All in Real Time.
hero.subheadline: Give support teams, operators, and digital leaders one place to monitor outages, answer customer billing questions, and trigger proactive utility actions.

painPoints: Long customer call queues during outage windows
Limited feeder and transformer visibility across teams
Manual alert triage that delays response
Escalating support costs and inconsistent service quality

features.title: Real-Time Grid Monitoring
features.description: Track substations, feeders, and transformers with continuously refreshed usage and alerting views.

features.title: Utility Self-Service Support Chat
features.description: Deflect repetitive support tickets with instant, traceable answers to customer questions.

features.title: Proactive Outage Detection
features.description: Spot anomalies early with event scoring and clear priority flags for operations teams.

features.title: Customer-Friendly Bill Explanations
features.description: Translate usage spikes and tariff tiers into plain-language explanations customers can trust.

features.title: Load Balance Recommendations
features.description: Highlight peak-hour feeder pressure and suggest balancing actions before service degrades.

features.title: Multi-Channel Enablement
features.description: Serve guidance across chat, web, and support consoles with a shared response logic.

outputs.title: Customer Usage Explainer
outputs.description: Provide guided explanations for seasonal usage shifts, slab changes, and unusual meter behavior with source references from your data snapshot.

outputs.title: Outage Heatmaps
outputs.description: Render current outage intensity in a glanceable grid to prioritize dispatch and communication before issue volume spikes.

outputs.title: Load Spike Detection
outputs.description: Automatically flag sudden feeder demand increases and pair each alert with likely root-cause candidates.

outputs.title: Ticketless Resolution
outputs.description: Resolve routine customer intents automatically while preserving a complete transcript for audit and training improvements.
